outcome: correlation between maternal and umbilical cord blood (UCB) 25(OH)D
cohort: 235 pregnant women who underwent labor and delivery
finding: The correlation between maternal and umbilical cord blood 25(OH)D levels is very strong throughout low to high maternal levels of 25(OH)D, with lower levels in maternal blood.
mod_finding: For women who delivered by caesarean section in the second stage, the correlation between maternal and umbilical cord blood 25(OH)D levels remained strong.
